e2m Idle_Speed_Save_Enable (LSISSVEN, saves the last idle speed at shutdown). No reader in either bank (sweep of both banks). Clear in this calibration (0x2e06). (was reserved_bit_0; named from its e2m record in PR #53 round 20, as in algorithm_enable_flags_3_t)
e2m Overspeed_FSO_Override (EPOSFSO, fuel shut-off valve on overspeed). No reader in either bank (sweep of both banks). Set in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m Water_In_Fuel_Enable (WFAGEN). cm848_sendPgn65279WaterInFuelIndicatorMessage (lhz at 0x26ea0: the PGN 65279 byte stays 0xff while clear) and cm848_monitorWaterInFuel (lhz at 0x5103b8: clears fault 56 bit 0x100 while clear). Code agrees with the e2m label. Set in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m AFC_Override_Enable (AFENMAN). cm848_calculateAirFuelControlFuelLimit (lhz 24(r26) at 0xdcf4): while clear it computes the limit from air_fuel_control_fuel_limit_grid, so set overrides it. Code agrees. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m ESP_Enable (SPAGEN; ESP = Electronic Smart Power per e2m Group_ESP_8). hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput (lhz at 0xe71c) and cm848_calculateThrottle100Fuelings (lhz at 0x1f290): while set the four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor is zeroed around cm848_calculateMaximumFuelCurve. A reader exists but its behaviour is not tied to the e2m label. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m Reverse_ESP_Enable (SPRVEN, Electronic Smart Power launch application). No reader in either bank (sweep of both banks). Clear in this calibration (0x2e06). (was reserved_bit_5; named from its e2m record in PR #53 round 20, as in algorithm_enable_flags_3_t)

e2m LSG_Droop_Enable (LSDPEN). cm848_updateProtectionParameters (lhz at 0x20b90) and cm848_calculateFaultDerateJ1939TorqueCurveSpeedPoints (lhz at 0x507a70): while set the governor integrator output is reduced by governor_integrator_correction_term times ROM 0x5c352 divided by 167 (a droop). Code agrees. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m Accelerator_Interlock_Enable (ANEN). cm848_claimAcceleratorInterlockThrottleOverride (lhz at 0x403e8: with switch 26 set it forces the fuel demand override to its minimum) and cm848_j1939BuildEngineControlByte (lhz 24(r5) at 0x25788). Code agrees. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m VSS_Moving_Enable (VSMVEN): the sensor drops to 0 while the filtered speed is still above 10 mph. Named after the detector it gates. cm848_detectVehicleSpeedSensorSignalLoss (lhz at 0x526950, P0500 path 1) and cm848_clearHealedVehicleSpeedSensorFault (lhz at 0x526be8). Code agrees. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m VSS_Stopped_Enable (VSSTEN): the sensor reads stopped (0) while the engine is under load. Named after the detector it gates. cm848_detectVehicleSpeedSensorZeroUnderLoad (lhz at 0x5269fc, P0500 path 2) and cm848_clearHealedVehicleSpeedSensorFault (lhz at 0x526bd8). Code agrees: the sensor reads 0 while the engine is under load. Set in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m OBD_Fault_Handler_Enable (DGOBFUHN). 11 fault framework functions test it (cm848_registerFaultInActiveList at 0x1cf1c, cm848_clearDiagnosticState, cm848_processFaultScanGroup, diagnosticMainStateProcessor, cm848_updateFaultEntryCounters, cm848_resetFaultStatus, hpcr_setFaultActiveStatus, cm848_requestClearInactiveFaults, cm848_j1939HandlePgn65228Dm3ClearInactiveFaults, cm848_completeBoostPressureMonitorReport, cm848_monitorEgrOrificeTemperatureSensorRationality); the names agree, the bodies were not read. Set in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m PTO_Brake_Override_Enable (PTBRODEN). cm848_runPowerTakeOffGovernorStateMachine (lhz 24(r31) at 0x2b214) pairs it with power_take_off_governor_switch_state_bits 0x10000, which that function sets from switch 11 (brake), to leave power take off control. Code agrees. Set in this calibration (0x2e06).

e2m PTO_Clutch_Override_Enable (PTCHODEN). The same function pairs it with power_take_off_governor_switch_state_bits 0x4000, set from switch 15 (clutch). Code agrees. Clear in this calibration (0x2e06).
e2m OCM_Enable (OCEA). cm848_updateOilChangeMonitor (lhz at 0x51a89c), together with feature_selection_bits_cal mask 4. Code agrees. Set in this calibration (0x2e06).
